incidents.title: Intermittent SMS delivery failures during high traffic
incidents.root_cause: Downstream SMS gateway rate limiting during end-of-month salary dispatches. Resolved by configuring connection pool backoff.

incidents.title: Floating point mismatch on high-volume currency conversion
incidents.root_cause: Rounding logic in foreign exchange converter suffered minor rounding drift on specific decimal currencies.
incidents.resolution: Migrated FX rate multiplication to Decimal.

incidents.title: Double debit reported on rapid submit button click
incidents.root_cause: Frontend submitted duplicate requests before disabling submit button. Idempotency middleware added to reject identical keys.
incidents.resolution: Enforced client Idempotency-Key header on POST /api/transfers.

changes.title: Implement Daily Limit Check (₹1,00,000 threshold)
changes.author: dev-limits@bank.org
changes.description: Enforce ₹1,00,000 daily cumulative retail transfer cap.

changes.title: Refactor SMS notification dispatch pipeline
changes.author: dev-comms@bank.org
changes.description: Modernize SMS gateway client to asynchronous HTTP calls. Legacy 3-attempt inline retry loop removed in favor of gateway client default.

changes.title: Update same-day RTGS/NEFT cutoff window policy
changes.author: dev-payments@bank.org
changes.description: Enforce 16:00 cutoff time check for same-day settlements.

changes.title: chore: bump httpx timeout config to 15s
changes.author: dev-infra@bank.org
changes.description: Increase default downstream HTTP client timeout from 5s to 15s to absorb latency spikes.

known_errors.title: Bank-holiday NEFT settlement batch delay
known_errors.pattern: NEFT batch settlements delayed or marked PENDING_SETTLEMENT on official RBI bank holidays
known_errors.root_cause: The Reserve Bank of India clearing house does not process clearing batches on national bank holidays and 2nd/4th Saturdays. Outbound batches remain queued in PENDING_SETTLEMENT state until next clearing window.
known_errors.workaround: No manual intervention or database fix required. Queued transfer batches automatically clear and settle at 08:00 IST on the following business day. Inform client of the statutory holiday schedule.

known_errors.title: Core banking ledger maintenance window Sunday 02:00-04:00 IST
known_errors.pattern: 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE from CBS during early Sunday maintenance
known_errors.root_cause: Scheduled core banking ledger index reorganization.
known_errors.workaround: Retry transfer after 04:00 IST. Transmit advisory to client portal.
